# Development status and limitations

This is a 0.1.0 development release, NOT fulfillment of the full high-quality production specification. Do not relabel as 1.0 or claim all requested features exist.

## Scope reductions / remaining work

* UE5 and Blender were absent. Godot was selected. Models use original procedural assemblies, not Blender-authored UV/baked/rigged assets. Surface textures and crew illustrations are generated by a reproducible Python tool. No normal-map baking or rigging pipeline yet.
* Flight and construction are 3D, but normal flight is assisted to a shallow belt plane. No six-degree-of-freedom vertical input. Construction is a single X/Z layer, not a volumetric grid.
* Eleven functional shop module types, not the full 28+ requested equipment variants. Only mining beam, pulse cannon and unguided rocket are available. No guided missiles, railgun, defense drones, automation or full ship rearrangement tool. Removal/reinstallation provides rebuilding with a refund cost.
* Five sector configurations and scaling enemy stats, but enemy ships share one procedural chassis with gun/rocket variations. There are not five distinct fully authored enemy classes. Only Plasma Storm has a periodic environmental damage hazard.
* Individual module HP disables equipment and visibly shrinks destroyed modules; modules remain attached. Main hull damage is also tracked independently. Ship layout survives a lost expedition. No debris detachment simulation.
* Forty distinct procedural portrait illustrations exist. Rarity-specific frame colors and card flip/fan/floating effects are implemented; the full premium pack model/opening/cosmic/secret cinematic is not implemented.
* Achievement UI is a timed contract list, not thirty independently illustrated achievement cards. Some long-period objectives repeat with higher counts. Minute tasks avoid mandatory combat but a universal 20–40-second completion guarantee has not been validated across ship configurations.
* Active research effects are directly selectable free +20% disciplines. The rare fifth-slot roll is a separate 1% per paid pack (not per card); this is stated in UI. No paid real-money system.
* Crew has seven role bonuses with linear additive stacking. The data does not cover every requested example of a named mythic/legendary specialty.
* Basic sound effects; no composed soundtrack, voice acting, spatial audio mix, localization, controller mapping, rebinding, or graphics presets yet.
* No fullscreen title/main-menu cinematic; launch opens the hangar. Camera orbit/pan can be moved into hangar geometry; a full camera collision system is unfinished.
* Saves persist hangar state/progression; returning sells cargo. Closing mid-expedition forfeits unbanked cargo. Local UTC clocks are not trusted-server time: rollback does not reset a bucket, but arbitrary forward clock changes are not cheat-proof.
* Save format version 1 rejects unknown versions; migration from the unrelated older browser game is not supported.
* Unsigned binaries. No SmartScreen signing. Performance, readability, input feel, and rendering must be tested interactively on multiple physical Windows PCs before a production release.

## Validation reporting

Actual CI test results, logs, screenshot, artifact sizes and hashes will be published only when generated. Headless scene tests are not a substitute for human interactive QA. No claim of complete gameplay verification or bug-free production readiness is made.
